purpose: Rebaseline the UAV ESC product from the former 70-100 kg payload heavy-lift vehicle to a 1.5-3.0 kW aggregate-propulsion product family while preserving non-conflicting control/safety/process decisions.

change_control.rule: PB-07 supersedes incompatible PB-06 vehicle, battery and ESC sizing values. Later changes to PB-07 frozen values require PB-08 or an explicitly linked ECO; no silent overwrite is allowed.

new_frozen_decisions.rationale: User-approved product pivot: a 1.5-3.0 kW total-propulsion UAV is sufficient, so the previous heavy-lift sizing is no longer the active product objective.

superseded_items: 70-100 kg payload target and 85 kg nominal payload
>=500 A continuous and >=1050 A for >=3 s whole-pack requirements
>=4.8 kW continuous and >=11.5 kW short-duration per-ESC requirements
>=125 A RMS / >=265 A RMS / >=375 A peak phase-current requirements
>=90 keRPM controller requirement derived from the old 45KV/42-pole envelope

retained_non_conflicting_decisions.value: CAN-FD capable with Classic CAN compatibility
power-up/reset DISARMED; independent hardware inhibit final authority; latched fault inhibits PWM; no automatic re-arm

rotor_architecture.reason: At equal 1.5-3.0 kW aggregate input, current 28-30 inch market curves show the hexa operating each rotor at a more efficient lower-power point, at the cost of two extra propulsion units.

battery_voltage.reason: Current 28-30 inch reference propulsion systems directly support the 12S-14S class; 3 kW at 12S is only about 68-83 A over nominal-to-low-loaded-bus screening.

derived_screening_results_not_frozen.interpretation: Approximately 15-18 kg MTOW at the 3 kW upper study point is a credible exploration band with a 1.6 T/W screen, but exact MTOW and payload remain OPEN.

reopened_product_items: vehicle operating-empty mass budget and MTOW
exact motor/propeller MPN and winding parameters
battery series/parallel count, loaded bus, energy, mass, sag and BMS
per-ESC continuous/short-duration power and DC current
phase RMS/peak current and current-sense range
environment, protection thresholds and thermal design
anti_hallucination_rule: PB-07 freezes only the product-family power direction and explicit retained policies. Quad/Hexa, 12S/14S, MTOW, payload, cell topology and component choices remain candidates until later controlled decisions. Manufacturer curves are sizing evidence, not flight qualification.
